summary: IDC MarketScape named Ottimate a leader in the 2026 AI-Enabled Accounts Payable Automation Software for midmarket. See how growing companies keep business complexity from becoming finance complexity.
body_markdown:
IDC MARKETSCAPE® · 2026 VENDOR ASSESSMENT


# No two midmarket businesses run the same. Why would their AP?


See why analysts say growing companies’ AP technology decision is shaped by complexity, not transaction volume alone.


## What IDC MarketScape found for midmarket AI-enabled AP


Two businesses can look identical on paper and still have completely different AP needs. IDC MarketScape studied what actually differentiates them.


#### Same headcount. Very different AP problem.


More entities. More systems. More exceptions. Ottimate absorbs the complexity so your team doesn’t have to.


#### Automation stops where exceptions start.


Missing matches and unclear codes eat your team’s time. Ottimate resolves them automatically.


#### One workflow. Every entity and ERP.


Every new entity adds another manual workaround. Ottimate replaces it with one process.


## Frequently Asked Questions


The vendor inclusion list for this IDC MarketScape was designed to represent accounts payable automation software providers relevant to organizations with 100–999 employees.


IDC considered market presence, product maturity, customer profile, functional depth, integration capabilities, operational scalability, and the vendor’s ability to support AP environments that may include multiple entities, systems, approval structures, and increasing transaction complexity.


Finance leaders managing multiple entities, systems, or approval structures, especially in hospitality, grocery, or healthcare.


If your business brings in $5M to $1B a year in hospitality, grocery, or healthcare, yes. Ottimate runs exclusively in North America today.
